book.name: Hebreos
book.title: Hebreo aents aidau carta agaja awetimu

content: Yaunchuk chicham umiktin aajakua duka aentsnak yaigchauwai

Chicham umiktin Moisés agagbauwa duka Apajuí pegkeg aidaun amastina nuna iwainajakui; tujash duka dekaskesh wajukuita nu aajakchauwai, nunin asa makichkish aentsnak pegkejak emamainchau aajakui, Apajuin adijkatasag makí makichik mijantin kuntinun maawag apejakú aina nunak dutikainakush.
Chicham umiktina nu dekaskenum tudaun nijag pegkeg emamu ainakug, nuwi takaina duka kuntin mautnak idaisag nuigtuk tudaunumak bakumamainchau anentaimain ainawai.
Tujash nunú kuntin maamua duka ayatak ashí mijantin ditá tudaujinak anemtikajakui.
Wagki toro numpe, chivo numpe aina duka aentsú tudaujinak jujumainchau asamtai.
Nuadui Cristo nugká taatin asa Apajuin tiuwai:

content.text: Nuniau asam minak aentsú iyashijai betek etiume.
Kuntin maa apeamu, nuigtú tudau tsagkugnagtasa anentag itaamu aidaushkam dakitame.
‘Apajuiyah, mina pachitus papinum agajajua nuna, ame wakegamu umiktasan jui pujajai’, tibaijame”.

content: Nuna nagkamas takug: “Apajuik kuntin maamu, anentag itaamu, tudau tsagkugnagtasa kuntin maa apeamu aina nunak dakitawai, shiig awagmatsui tawai. Chicham umiktina nuwi dutikatajum tibauwa nunin aigkish”.
Ataktú takushkam: “Wi, ame wakegam nuna umiktasan minajai” tiuwai. Nunak yaunchuk kuntin maajakbauwa duka emegkakum, yamagmauchia nu apusata taku tiuwai.
Nuadui jutiinak Apajuí pegkemtijabiajui, Jesucristo Apajuí wakegamun umiak makichkia mantamna ajumaish jakashtinun nunikua dui.
Ashí sacerdote aidauk kuntin maa apeamua nunak kashí kashinig dita dutiktaijinak dutiksag takaajakú ainawai, tudaunash makichkish utsanjamainchau aig.
Tujash Jesucristuk tudau aidaunum tsagkamankauwai, nunik tuke atinun makichkia mantamna Apajuí untsujin ekeemsauwai.
Nuwi yamaik dakak pujawai, “ni shiwaji aidaunak ashí niinig Apajuí depetuk ikaunmakti” tusa.
Nuna niina iyashin anentag Apajuin susauwa dui, midau atí tibau aina nunak tuke atinun pegkeemtikiuwai.
Dutiksag Wakaní Pegkejiya dushakam shiig dekamtijamji nuniak:

content.text: “Nunú tsawan atina dui wi ditajai chichaman apaktinaitag duka juuwai, tawai Apu Apajuí: Wi ditá anentain chicham umiktinnak egketjagtatjai, dutikakun ditá anentaimtajinish agatjagtatjai.
Ditá pegkegchauji, tudauji aidaunash ajumaish adeagchatnun kajimatkitnaitjai”.

content: Nuadui iina tudaujinak Apajuí tsagkugtamjau asamtai, tsagkugnagtasa kuntin mautak atsumnatsui.
Apajuiyai jegamainaitji
Yatsug aidauh, yamaik Jesucristo numpen ukajua dui, Apajuí pujutaiji shiig pegkegma nuwi waimainuk agkan ajutjamui,
yamajam jintan Jesús ujatjabiuwa nuwi weenaku pujut tuke atinnum jegamaina nuna, nunak ni jatai jaanch ejaamu ichiinkau ajakua dui dutikauwai,
Jesusai jutii sacerdoteji dekas senchigtin Apajuí jeen puja duka.
Nuadui Apajuik dekaskenum, dekaskeapi tabauwai jegaantagmi, dekaskeap nuninaita tusa, iina anentaimtajinish pegkegchau atsau, iyashish yumi dekas pegkejai dijagbau amaina iman wajasá.
Nunin asamtai ni anagkagtuamua nu dakaku pujuidautik ebetmamja batsamsagmi, dekaskeap uminkattawa tusaja, wagki Apajuik tibaujinak imatiksag betek umin asamtai.
Pempeentunisaikish wajuk yainimainaita nu egakagmi. Pegkeg takainaku nuní nagkaemasa aneenimaina nu.
Apajuí ememattasa ijunbaunmag megkaekachagmi, ujumak taachush ainawai nuní unuimatjau asag, nuna nunin aidaush yaigtajum wakeetan jukitnume, wagki Cristo minitnujiya duka tikiju wajasú asamtai.

Wagki Apajuí chichame dekaskea nunú dekau ainayatku, jutii wakeetajin pegkegchau takaaku Cristo shiwagmakuik, nuigtú iina tudaujin tsagkugtamjatatus Cristo mantamdauwa nunik tudaunum mantamnamainuk tikichik atsawai.
Ayatak jii shiig ishamainnum Apajuí niina shiwaji aidaun suwimkan susatna nunak dakainawai.

Nuadui makichik aentskesh Moisés chicham umiktajum tibaun umikchamtaig, jimag aentskesh, nuniachkush kampatumkesh apu aidaun jegajiag, nunú aents chichaman umitsuk wainak takaawai tusag etsegtukagmataig, wait anentug tsagkugtsuk maajakú ainawai.

Tujash nuna nagkaesau, Apajuí Uchijiya nuna dakituinak, niina numpe ukaejamunum Apajuijai chichaman apak pegkeemtikiuwa nunash pegkegchau diinak, Wakan wait anenkagtina nunash pegkegchau chichajuidau asag shiig senchi suwimkanak jukiagtinai.

Apajuí chichaak: “Witjai aents tikichin pegkegchau awagbaun suwimkan suwaunuk, nunin asan aents pegkegchaunak wi suwimkan susattajai”, tawai. Junashkam: “Niina aentsji aidaunak Apajuí ni titinai”, tawai.
¡Tikima shiig ishamainai, Apajuí iwaaku tuke pujuuwa nunú suwimak sukagtamuk!
Tujash adeagtajum, nagkamchakjum Apajuí chichame dekaajum Cristui sujumankajum ashí utugchat, waitiamu akuish, katsunjá ichichmamjajum depetkauwaitjum nunú.
Wagki atum ainajum anuiyatijum, tuwakbaunum pegkegchau chichagku waitkasbautigmesh ainagme, nuniagmin tikich aidauk aents dutika waitkamu aina nujai ijuntsan waittsatjai tusa anentaimsaush ainawai.

Atumek Cristo nemajuidau achikam chimpijush wait anenjauwaitjume. Tuja atumi shiwajum wajiigmin yajutjamkagmataish, atumek shiig aneasjum pujagme, atum jukitnuk nayaimpinum dekas shiig pegkeg tuke atin ajutjamaina nu dekau asajum.
Cristui kajintsá anentaimjum nunú megkaekaigpa, wagki atum jukitna duka shiig pegkeg ajutjamu asamtai.
Atumek atsumagme waitiakjumesh ichichmamja pujusjum, Apajuí wakegamua nu takaakjum, ni anagtamamua nu jukitasajum.
Agagbaunum chichaak:

content.text: Mina aentsug pegkejan takaa duka imá dekaskeapi tabauwaik tuke pujutnai,
untsu mina nemagtukuitak ataktú waketuidaunak shiig anentsashtinaitjai”, tawai.

content: Jutiik aents suwimka jukiagtin aidau Cristo nemagkau ainayatak ataktú waketuina nuninuk ainatsji, ayatak dekaskeapi tabauwai uwemtan jukiaju aina nuninuk jutiishkam ainaji.
